documents.text: News-Democrat & Leader The News-Democrat & Leader is a twice-weekly newspaper in Russellville, Kentucky. It has been published since 1806, fourteen years after Kentucky became a state. Russellville is the county seat of Logan County. The current title was formed with the merging of "The Logan County News" and "The Democrat" in 1911. Then in 1968, employees of the "News-Democrat" started a paper called "The Logan Leader".
